marketSummary: Indian equities have come under sharp selling pressure as the benchmark Nifty 50 surrendered key psychological and technical support at 24,500, ending at 24,472.10. The broad-based rout—led by high-beta PSU banks, metals, and real estate—is primarily driven by relentless Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) net selling exceeding ₹80,000 crore month-to-date, rising US Treasury yields, and an underwhelming debut from Hyundai Motor India. For swing traders, the breakdown of short-term moving average support across the broader indices elevates failure rates for classic base and cup-and-handle breakouts, demanding strict risk parameters, lower position sizing, and a rotation toward high relative-strength pockets such as select IT and EMS/capital goods.
dailyFocus: Prioritize capital preservation by avoiding premature dip-buying in overextended momentum names; track structural base-defense in defense majors (HAL, BEL) and focus swing entries exclusively on stocks demonstrating resilient relative strength post-Q2 results.

sectors.name: Information Technology
sectors.reason: Displaying visible relative strength amidst broad market weakness, supported by solid Q2 constant-currency revenue growth and steady deal wins.
catalysts: Resilient earnings delivery and deal total contract value (TCV) expansions across tier-1 and tier-2 IT
Depreciating rupee acting as an earnings tailwind
risks: Continued US macroeconomic interest rate uncertainty delaying enterprise discretionary spending recovery

sectors.name: Capital Goods & Electronics Manufacturing
sectors.reason: Strong order book visibility and secular electronics manufacturing services (EMS) localization offsetting short-term broad market multiple contraction.
catalysts: Solid Q2 operating numbers and capacity additions
Accelerating localization and production-linked incentive (PLI) execution
risks: Secondary market liquidity constraints and fundraise equity dilution

sectors.name: Defence & Shipbuilding
sectors.reason: Experiencing healthy technical corrections and digesting government supply offloads following multi-quarter rallies, while structural multi-year order backlogs remain intact.
catalysts: Maharatna status enhancement and large export pipeline
Operationalization of massive drydock and ship repair infrastructure
risks: Government Offer for Sale (OFS) supply overhangs
Short-term valuation consolidation after multi-year rallies

sectors.name: Automotive & Consumer Discretionary
sectors.reason: Dampened sentiment following the discounted listing of Hyundai Motor India, persistent concerns over elevated urban channel inventories, and slower festive demand pickup.
catalysts: Selective late-festive wedding season retail consumption
risks: Muted same-store-sales growth (SSSG) and promotional margin discounting

sectors.name: Banking & Financial Services
sectors.reason: Bearing the brunt of relentless foreign portfolio capital outflows, net interest margin (NIM) contraction, and micro-credit stress in unsecured segments.
catalysts: Consistent double-digit loan book expansions in secured retail franchises
risks: Relentless institutional selling pressure in heavyweights
Rising credit costs and slippages in unsecured retail portfolios

news.headline: Amber Enterprises Hits Record 52-Week High as Q2 Revenue Jumps 82% YoY
news.summary: Amber Enterprises India surged over 8% after reporting stellar Q2 FY25 results, with revenue climbing 82% YoY to ₹1,685 crore and net profit swinging to ₹21 crore. Strong volume traction across air-conditioner manufacturing and railway subsystem electronics drove the breakout.
news.impact: Textbook earnings breakout accompanied by massive volume expansion; watch for shallow 3-day pullback re-tests toward the prior resistance shelf for swing entry.

news.headline: Zomato Q2 Net Profit Soars Nearly 5-Fold to ₹176 Crore; Approves ₹8,500 Crore QIP
news.summary: Zomato reported a 389% YoY surge in consolidated net profit to ₹176 crore for Q2 FY25, with revenue jumping 68% to ₹4,799 crore, powered by rapid expansion in its Blinkit quick-commerce unit. The board concurrently approved raising up to ₹8,500 crore via QIP to strengthen cash balances.
news.impact: Outstanding operational growth offset by short-term dilution overhang; watch for orderly base formation around the 20-day moving average.

news.headline: Nifty Breaks 24,500 Psychological Support as FII Outflows Accelerate Past ₹80,000 Crore in October
news.summary: The NSE Nifty 50 slumped 309 points (1.25%) to close at 24,472.10, triggering a breakdown below its 50-day moving average. Relentless institutional selling by foreign portfolio investors, driven by rising US benchmark yields and geopolitical tensions, has led to a broad-based decline across 47 of 50 index constituents.
news.impact: Decisive breakdown below the 24,500 swing support elevates breakout failure risks; swing traders should cut long exposure and raise cash levels.

news.headline: CG Power Approves ₹3,500 Crore QIP Fundraise Alongside Q2 Results
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions reported its Q2 FY25 financial results at its board meeting on October 21. The board concurrently approved raising capital up to ₹3,500 crore via Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) in one or more tranches to finance ongoing industrial and semiconductor packaging capex.
news.impact: Imminent supply from a ₹3,500 crore equity dilution combined with operational margin pressure suggests immediate overhead resistance at range highs.

news.headline: BEL Schedules Q2 FY25 Board Meeting for October 25 as Order Book Stands at ₹74,595 Crore
news.summary: Navratna defence PSU Bharat Electronics Limited confirmed its board meeting on Friday, October 25, 2024, to approve un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2024. The company's confirmed order book position heading into Q2 stood at a robust ₹74,595 crore.
news.impact: Pre-earnings volatility and recent 3.8% pullback offer a potential low-risk swing entry only if the stock defends key ascending trendline support before Friday's print.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Absorbs Government 5% OFS at Discovered Clearing Price of ₹1,542.50
news.summary: The Government of India successfully concluded the sale of 1.31 crore equity shares (up to 5% stake) in Cochin Shipyard Limited via Offer for Sale (OFS), setting a clearing price of ₹1,542.50 per share. Meanwhile, the shipyard's newly constructed International Ship Repair Facility (ISRF) and dry dock expand vessel-handling capacity.
news.impact: The OFS floor clearing level at ₹1,542.50 serves as immediate price gravity; wait for base stabilization above this benchmark before trading long setups.

news.headline: Persistent Systems Posts Strong 5.8% QoQ USD Revenue Growth with TCV Deal Wins of $529M
news.summary: Persistent Systems reported a 5.8% sequential growth in USD revenues to $412.4 million for Q2 FY25, accompanied by margin expansion of 50 bps and an interim dividend declaration. Total Contract Value (TCV) order bookings achieved a record quarterly high of $529.3 million.
news.impact: Exhibiting leading relative strength among midcap IT; price pullbacks toward rising 10-day EMA offer favorable asymmetric swing continuation entries.

news.headline: Bajaj Finance Delivers 13% YoY PAT Growth in Q2 FY25 as AUM Reaches ₹3.73 Lakh Crore
news.summary: Bajaj Finance reported consolidated profit after tax of ₹4,014 crore for Q2 FY25, up 13% YoY, with customer franchise expanding to 92.09 million and Assets Under Management (AUM) jumping 29% YoY. New loans booked rose 14%, though net interest margin (NIM) faced mild compression from elevated funding costs.
news.impact: Results confirm healthy balance sheet growth but lack an upside surprise to break out of its 6-month rectangle base; remain neutral until ₹7,400 clears.

news.headline: Trent Digests Massive YTD Gains as Street Assesses Store Productivity Ahead of Q2 Print
news.summary: Trent continues to hold sideways consolidation near the upper boundary of its structural channel following a sharp year-to-date rally. The market is actively weighing rapid Zudio store openings against moderating industry same-store-sales growth (SSSG) ahead of its upcoming Q2 earnings scheduled for early November.
news.impact: Tight multi-week range-bound trading indicates institutional accumulation; avoid front-running until a clean volume-backed breakout above ₹8,100 emerges.

news.headline: HAL Absorbs Defence Sector Correction Following Milestone Maharatna Status Upgrade
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited is consolidating within its multi-month consolidation pattern following its formal upgrade to 'Maharatna' CPSE status by the Ministry of Finance. The status grants HAL enhanced autonomy to commit capital expenditures up to 15% of net worth and invest up to ₹5,000 crore in joint ventures without prior Cabinet clearance.
news.impact: The regulatory upgrade improves long-term capital deployment speed; wait for price contraction along the 100-day moving average to establish a base.
